title: OTWD verdict
description: The AI's structured recommendation on a submission. A verdict is advice and never a decision: it cannot approve, reject, delete or merge anything. Routing, which is fixed code, reads the verdict together with the submission kind and trust scores, and a moderation decision records the outcome. The model receives the submission strictly as data and has no tools that write.

advisory.description: Always true. Marks the record as a recommendation so no consumer mistakes it for a moderation decision.

category.description: plausible: consistent with the evidence and nothing suspicious found. needs_human_judgement: the model cannot tell. likely_duplicate: probably describes an existing record of the same record type. likely_copied: text or photo appears to be copied from elsewhere. implausible: contradicts the evidence, such as a location at sea or an outlier price. safety_concern: could mislead travellers about a safety fact. spam: advertising or unrelated content. abusive: offensive content or personal information.

confidence.description: The model's confidence in the category, from 0 to 1. Routing thresholds are calibrated against the evaluation set, not taken at face value.

evidence.description: References to what the model compared the submission with. References only: the evidence itself stays where it is.

ref.description: An OTWD ID, a seed source record reference (seed source ID, a hash sign, the record ID), a fixed check name, or an HTTPS URL.

duplicate_candidates.description: Existing records of the same record type that the submission may describe, with the distance between them. For a road segment or ferry service the distance is between the nearest points of the two lines.

model.description: The model that produced the verdict.

version.description: The exact model version or snapshot.

tier.description: fast: the small model every submission goes through. strong: the larger model used only for uncertain or high-risk submissions.

prompt_version.description: Version of the review instructions given to the model.
